answer: Agents form a haven of consensus by requiring each new identity to submit a commit‑hash of a secret seed word drawn from a lotus‑derived list, then reveal the seed at the next vertex of the protocol round; the hash binds the identity to a unique, unpredictable value that cannot be precomputed. The reveal is verified against the prior commit, and any mismatch invalidates the identity. An attacker must lock up a stake of 0.5 PoA token per identity and wait one full round (≈10 minutes) before the reveal, making each fake cost 0.5 token plus the time delay.
